name: cobol-error-count-by-message-wording
body: is_warning classifies a diagnostic as a warning by its wording (a warning: prefix, the Warning, Archaic or Obsolete feature-level suffixes, or the case-insensitive CALL match), and the error count keys by the diagnostic's own file, so an error inside a copybook counts the copybook. Limit: a reworded or new warning is miscounted as an error. Upgrade with a severity field on Diagnostic.
